stem.text: When bacteria are grown in a Petri dish containing discs with antibiotics, there will be zones of inhibition of bacterial growth.

stem.alt: Circular Petri dish diagram with a central antibiotic disc, a clear zone of inhibition around it and a grey area of bacterial growth, with leader lines labelled antibiotic disc, zone of inhibition and area of bacterial growth.

stem.text: The chart shows the size of the zones of inhibition when a species of bacteria was incubated on five different plates of agar, each containing a disc with a different antibiotic.

stem.alt: Bar chart on a grid of zone of inhibition in mm against antibiotic, numbered 1 to 5, with five bars.

stem.text: Which conclusions can be made about the most and least effective antibiotics on this species of bacteria?
